title: Musk's SpaceX AI Team Will Stream: Building a Company from Scratch in Three Days Using Grok Bot
excerpt: Elon Musk's SpaceX AI team announced that they will hold a three-day live stream event from September 15th to 17th, local time, showcasing how the team members
content_html:
Elon Musk's SpaceX AI team announced that they will hold a three-day live stream event from September 15th to 17th, local time, showcasing how the team members use Grok Bot to develop a business plan, determine product features, and complete actual engineering work, transforming concepts into operational businesses.

The live stream will run from 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM daily. The team will demonstrate in real-time the process from product concept to engineering development and introduce the practical workflow of Grok Bot at different stages of the business through special sessions by various departments.

In terms of the schedule, September 15th is the first day, including an introduction to Grok Bot, engineering development, and special sessions for product managers and founders; September 16th focuses on sales engineering, sales, sales development representatives (SDRs), and customer support; September 17th includes marketing operations, post-sales, and marketing special sessions.

During the event, the SpaceX AI team will also demonstrate how Grok Bot participates in all aspects, from writing the first line of code to helping customers succeed, and share specific application cases for different job functions.
